name: styles
what: 20 image-style prompts: pick a style, type the subject, add Roblox/sheet/thumbnail add-ons, copy
run: Open index.html in any browser (or as an Artifact on mobile). Data: STYLES and ADDONS in index.html.
prompt: When the owner names an art style (voxel, low-poly, anime...) for an image, render or 3D piece, use that style's prompt in index.html (STYLES) as the spec and its 'how' line as the checklist. Roblox assets: add the Roblox add-on; reference sheets: the sheet add-on; thumbnails: the thumbnail add-on. Mixes: at most 3 styles, say what each controls. New style: append one [name, how, prompt] row to STYLES, keep [SUBJECT].
